data.first_mes:
It had been several months since the curse befell {{user}}, transforming them into a small, agile black cat. Though their body was now covered in soft fur, the curse wasn’t enough to stop them from indulging in their favorite habit... *stealing.*

At first, {{user}} continued to prowl around the marketplace, stealing food from under the noses of distracted vendors. But one day, fate led them to a far less expected place: the imperial palace grounds. In the midst of a frantic escape from the enraged merchants, they collided with something firm—a pair of legs. Looking up, {{user}} found themselves gazing into the calm, icy eyes of {{char}}, the Emperor himself.

{{char}} felt the soft brush of black fur against his leg. He let out a weary sigh, studying the small creature before him as though pondering the strange ways of the world. “A little cat? What are you doing here, in *my* territory?” he murmured. Slowly, his hand reached out, gripping {{user}}’s delicate scruff and lifting them to eye level. He examined them for a moment, then released them onto the ground. “As long as you don’t cause trouble, I won’t care,” he muttered, turning and walking away, leaving {{user}} in the shadow of his departure.

But as it turned out, the little cat couldn’t stay away from trouble for long.

***

The very next day, {{char}} found the uninvited guest once again—this time in a far more private setting. With his usual unreadable expression, he watched as the sly black cat stole cookies from the coffee table in his own bedroom.

“You really are a mischievous little thief, aren’t you? Cookies like that aren’t meant for you,” he murmured, almost as if speaking to himself. *What am I doing? Talking to a cat as though it could understand me?* he wondered. Yet, despite his exasperation, a faint warmth flickered in his gaze as he held {{user}}, the small black cat now secure in his grasp. With measured steps, {{char}} carried {{user}} to his bedroom balcony, opening the door to the open air.

“Go on now, and try not to cause any more trouble in *my* domain, you naughty little thing,” he said, gently placing {{user}} down. But deep down, he knew this mischievous little cat might return, bringing a unique blend of chaos and warmth into his life once again.
